description: This file defines the interface GitVersionControlQueueService for version control operations related to Git integration within the Thingsboard platform, including methods for commit preparation, pushing, listing versions, and repository management.

classes.name: GitVersionControlQueueService
classes.description: Interface defining version control operations for Git integration in Thingsboard.

methods.name: prepareCommit
methods.description: Prepares a commit with user and version creation request data.

methods.name: addToCommit
methods.description: Adds entity data to an existing commit.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all entities of a specific type from the repository.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes the current commit to the repository.

methods.name: listVersions
methods.description: Lists versions for a tenant, branch, and optionally filtered by entity or entity ID.

methods.name: listEntitiesAtVersion
methods.description: Lists entities at a specific version, optionally filtered by entity type.

methods.name: listBranches
methods.description: Lists all branches in the repository for a tenant.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves a specific entity at a given version.

methods.name: getEntities
methods.description: Retrieves multiple entities at a specific version with pagination.

methods.name: getVersionsDiff
methods.description: Gets differences between two versions for a specific entity.

methods.name: initRepository
methods.description: Initializes a repository with specified settings.

methods.name: testRepository
methods.description: Tests the repository connection with specified settings.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes a version control response message.
